label: Bible Study
prompt: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no _____, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
verse: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
note: Too many sheep, not enough pasture — Abram settles it by letting his nephew Lot choose first.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be _____ with us than with him:
verse: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:
note: Hezekiah faces Assyria's huge army with a simple headcount: there be more with us than with him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a _____, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
verse: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
note: A young lion roared at Samson, and he rent it as easily as a young goat — then told neither father nor mother.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have _____ the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
verse: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
note: Temple renovations turned up the forgotten book of the law, and King Josiah's great reforms began.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, _____ thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
verse: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
note: Enlarge the tent, 'lengthen thy cords' — the text of William Carey's 1792 'Expect great things' missions sermon.
